notes:
Account snapshot: SovereignAI is a payments/regtech platform (EU-headquartered) evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) to satisfy multi-jurisdictional data residency and strong KMS/audit controls. They have strict EU-only requirements for EU customers, separate UK-only routing for UK clients, and a Canada-only cluster for Canadian operations tied to PSP compliance. APAC (Singapore) is a near-term requirement for regional customers in 2026.

Key asks: full private control plane (VPC peering), Bring-Your-Own-KMS (Azure Key Vault + GCP KMS compatibility), audit log forwarding (SIEM integration), 7-year retention option for audit logs, SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning, support for on-prem connector for token vaulting.

Performance targets: chat p95 <200ms (EU region), embedding throughput ~200 req/s (batching OK), reranking latencies <250ms. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for residency + KMS/HSM guarantees.

Compliance comps: requires ISO27001 attestation and SOC2 Type II evidence. Legal asks for DPA + SCCs; procurement expects a dedicated-capacity quote and a runbook for incident response.

POC plan discussed: 4-week Private VPC POC scoped in eu-west (EU-only routing for EU customers, UK region for UK subset). POC success metrics: residency enforced (no tokens stored outside region), KMS key rotation tested, audit log ingestion to customer's Splunk instance, latency SLOs met.

Notes/quotes from calls: "If we can't guarantee EU-only residency for EU merchant data, we can't move forward." — Head of Infrastructure. "KMS must be HSM-backed and keys never leave our tenancy." — Legal/Controls.

Suggested Redwood approach: propose Private deployment with regional controls + routing policies, provide KMS integration playbook (Azure + GCP examples), deliver network peering diagram, and share SOC2/ISO evidence. Prepare a dedicated capacity price band and optional on-prem token vault add-on.
